changes: Group sends now create a cryptographically random UUID client_request_id and retain the exact encrypted payload, encrypted File objects, original files/metas and original text in account/group/device-scoped session memory. A synchronous preparation lock prevents duplicate encryption/transmission while the first request is being built.

Ambiguous errors retain a pending send. The explicit result-check action first queries the authenticated operation; completed outcomes resolve locally, committed outcomes explicitly request reconciliation, and missing/prepared operations replay the same payload/files without re-encryption or an unkeyed fallback. Failed authorization/network/rate-limit lookups are not followed by another POST.

202 stays pending, not success. Outcome group/request/message IDs, phase, file-count/index bounds and unique failure positions are checked; deleted outcomes are not reposted. Differing new caller content cannot silently substitute the old operation. Current client opts into the new server contract; older servers are not silently downgraded to unkeyed writes.

Pending UI blocks another send/Enter while preserving editable newer drafts and exposes a check/retry button with EN/TR status and session-only retention warning. Busy retries are locked. Unchanged original composer content is cleared only after a resolved retry; newer revisions/text/files survive.

Exact ciphertext results may use the original plaintext/file keys; edited replay ciphertext is decrypted instead, never stamped with original content. Newer live edit/delete versions fence older HTTP responses. Own-message WebSocket echoes arriving before HTTP can use the still-pending matching plaintext/key material without duplicating the message.

Account and membership deletion clear pending references. Device changes reject resumption; completed old-epoch requests can still be resolved after a group rekey without encrypting again. Failed-files recovery keeps its original source entry until an uncertain retry is resolved, then removes that source rather than inviting another duplicate retry.
